comparison.objective: Unfold, orient, and hang elastic folding headphones.
comparison.physical_skill: Articulated-object unfolding, passive-joint alignment, springy-band handling, and hanging.
comparison.success_condition: Fold joints opened, earcups oriented, headset released and stably hanging for 5 s. Damage thresholds are not detailed.
comparison.reason: Tests articulated-object configuration and hanging; generic bimanual orientation and release do not overlap with sifting.
